facts.fact: 骑行途中一声尖叫后，一名塞拉夫母亲抱着昏迷的儿子从林中冲出、跪地求救——男孩比Cora大几岁，肋侧插着一把银匕首，鲜血浸透上衣。
facts.anchor: A seraph breached the tree line, and a child, a few years older than Cora, lay limp in her arms. Her body trembled.

facts.fact: Rory把Cora留给Gabriel、越过他冲向伤者，并回身呵斥毫无紧迫感的士兵，喝令把她的satchel拿来。
facts.anchor: A mother in need of help from another mother. I pulled away from Cora, stepped around Gabriel, and ran to her side.

facts.fact: Rory求Gabriel治疗男孩，Gabriel拒绝：塞拉夫的治愈法术只对轻伤有效、这种伤势加匕首他治不了；Bonvis需要真正的healer，最近的一个在几英里外、男孩撑不到，Gabriel只能道歉。
facts.anchor: for minor injuries. He needs an actual healer. The closest is several miles away.

facts.fact: Rory倒空药袋，取yarrow、neem、dittany、horsetail四种草药；士兵Caleb送来水囊和大理石碗，她用石头把药捣碎、加水调成糊。
facts.anchor: I grabbed herbs of yarrow, neem, dittany, and horsetail. Caleb returned with a water skin and a marble bowl, placing them next to me.

facts.fact: Rory先向Airmed默祷求手稳，数到"三、二、一"后Gabriel从男孩Bonvis肋侧拔出匕首，Rory立刻按住伤口、把药糊敷进并压紧。
facts.anchor: Gabriel yanked the dagger from Bonvis, and I clapped my hand on the wound, keeping pressure.

facts.fact: Rory抬手查看后确认出血已止，Bonvis脉搏微弱但还活着；她与男孩母亲这对"母亲对母亲"同时松了口气（母亲随后自报姓名Sorah）。
facts.anchor: I slowly lifted my hand. We hung in a moment that would either tear this mother to pieces or gift her more time.

facts.fact: Gabriel下令士兵Norling立刻把Bonvis和母亲Sorah送去最近的healer救治、随后再回城堡汇合；Norling抱起男孩，母子随他骑马疾驰而去。
facts.anchor: Of course. Norling! Quickly get the youngling and his mother to the nearest healer and then meet us back at the castle.

facts.fact: Gabriel先赞Rory了不起，随即正色警告她别再贸然冲进危险场面——那可能是抢劫甚至伤人的圈套；Rory咽下争辩，像贵妇一样垂目点头，心里觉得屈辱。
facts.anchor: I must impress upon you, though, not to run off into dangerous situations. There was no telling if that was a ruse to lure us in to rob or even hurt us.

facts.fact: 重新上路前，Gabriel捡起遗落的带血银匕首收进自己的鞍袋；Rory搂着Cora感谢Clotha保佑女儿平安。
facts.anchor: Gabriel picked up the discarded bloody dagger and stuck it in his saddlebag.
